system.description:
Secret (a brass plate).

Study: any caster; 4 weeks, DC 15, learning to speak the name.

Teaches: once a year, a 1-hour ritual calls the fiend (the GM chooses it) into a circle you draw.

  • It can't leave the circle or harm you while the plate is whole.
  • Bargain with it, or bind it to one service; it keeps to the letter and looks for a loophole.
  • It hunts the plate always; if it takes the plate, it is free of everyone who learned its name.
  • One of the true names the Sorcerer King traded for his power, carved on a brass plate.
  • The fiend has been hunting it ever since.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Study it in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
